description: Operations & Reliability features: Health score dashboard, scheduled reports, multi-tenant support, offline mode, import/export ecosystem, and webhook integrations.
steps: 1. HEALTH SCORE DASHBOARD: Create app/services/health_score.py with HealthScoreService. Computes a composite score (0-100) from components: orphan_score (based on empty groups/orphan docs), lifecycle_score (overdue reviews + expired docs), backup_score (last backup age from settings), security_score (pending security alerts, failed auth from security_monitoring if available), storage_score (disk usage as % of reasonable limit), sla_score (SLA compliance %). Each component 0-100, composite is weighted average. Store daily scores in a new model.

2. Create app/models/health_score.py with HealthScoreRecord (id int PK, date date, composite_score float, orphan_score float, lifecycle_score float, backup_score float, security_score float, storage_score float, sla_score float, created_at datetime).
3. Create app/schemas/health_score.py with Pydantic models: HealthScoreResponse (composite_score, components dict, trend list), HealthScoreComponent (name, score, detail).
4. Create app/api/health_score.py with: GET /api/health/score (returns current composite score + breakdown), GET /api/health/score/history (returns daily trend data). Register in router.py.

5. Create app/templates/health_score_dashboard.html - HTML page with gauge visualization (SVG/CSS circular gauge showing 0-100) + breakdown bars per component + historical trend line chart. Add GET /pages/health-score route in app/api/pages.py.

6. SCHEDULED REPORTS: Create app/models/scheduled_report.py with ScheduledReport (id int PK, name str, schedule str (cron), report_type str enum, recipients JSON list, filters JSON, is_active bool, created_at, updated_at). Report types: weekly_summary, lifecycle_digest, compliance_snapshot, sla_report, security_digest.

7. Create app/services/scheduled_reports.py with ScheduledReportService that generates report content based on type (queries DB for relevant data, formats as HTML email body) and sends via EmailNotificationService.
8. Create app/schemas/scheduled_report.py with Pydantic CRUD models.
9. Create app/api/scheduled_reports.py with CRUD endpoints + POST /api/reports/{id}/trigger to manually trigger a report. Register in router.py.

10. MULTI-TENANT: Create app/models/tenant.py with Tenant (id int PK, name str, slug str unique, settings JSON, is_active bool, created_at). Add tenant_id (nullable int FK to tenants.id) columns to Document, Group, and User models for tenant isolation.

11. Create app/middleware/tenant.py - TenantMiddleware that resolves tenant from: X-Tenant-ID header, subdomain, or JWT claim. Sets request.state.tenant_id. If no tenant info found, defaults to None (single-tenant mode for backward compatibility).
12. Create app/schemas/tenant.py with Pydantic CRUD models for Tenant.

13. Create app/api/tenants.py with CRUD for tenants (admin only). Register in router.py. Note: actual query filtering is opt-in - middleware sets the tenant context but existing queries work as before (backward compatible).

14. OFFLINE MODE: Create app/services/offline_package.py with OfflinePackageService. POST /api/offline/generate accepts document_ids or group_id. Collects: document files (from storage), markdown content, metadata JSON. Generates a self-contained HTML viewer (inline CSS/JS with lunr.js search and navigation). Returns zip with: documents/, metadata.json, index.html (the viewer), search_index.json.
15. Create app/api/offline.py with: POST /api/offline/generate endpoint. Register in router.py.
16. Create app/schemas/offline.py with: OfflineRequest (document_ids: list[int] | None, group_id: int | None), OfflineResponse (download_url or streaming zip).

17. IMPORT/EXPORT ECOSYSTEM: Create app/services/import_export.py with ImportExportService. Import: accepts ZIP with manifest.json mapping files to folders, or CSV manifest (filename, folder_path, tags, lifecycle_type), or directory-structured zip. Export: generates full backup ZIP with all documents + metadata + wiki pages.
18. Create app/api/import_export.py with: POST /api/import (multipart upload), POST /api/export (generates and returns zip download). Register in router.py.
19. Create app/schemas/import_export.py with Pydantic models for import results and export options.

20. WEBHOOK INTEGRATIONS: Create app/models/webhook.py with WebhookConfig (id int PK, url str, secret str, events JSON list, is_active bool, headers JSON, created_at, updated_at). Events: document.uploaded, document.approved, document.expired, lifecycle.alert, security.alert, backup.completed.

21. Create app/services/webhooks.py with WebhookService. When event occurs, POST to webhook URL with JSON payload signed via HMAC-SHA256 (signature in X-Webhook-Signature header). Retry logic: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s).
22. Create app/api/webhooks.py with CRUD for webhook configs + POST /api/webhooks/{id}/test (sends test payload). Register in router.py.
23. Create app/schemas/webhook.py with Pydantic CRUD models.
24. Write tests in tests/test_health_score.py covering: score computation, history endpoint, component breakdown.
25. Write tests in tests/test_scheduled_reports.py covering: CRUD, trigger endpoint.
26. Write tests in tests/test_tenants.py covering: tenant CRUD, middleware tenant resolution.
27. Write tests in tests/test_offline.py covering: package generation with document_ids and group_id.
28. Write tests in tests/test_import_export.py covering: ZIP import with manifest, CSV import, full export.
29. Write tests in tests/test_webhooks.py covering: webhook CRUD, test endpoint, HMAC signature verification.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/health/score returns composite score 0-100 with component breakdown
Health score dashboard page renders at /pages/health-score with gauge visualization
ScheduledReport model supports CRUD with cron schedule and report types
POST /api/reports/{id}/trigger generates and sends a report
Tenant model exists with slug, settings JSON, is_active
tenant_id column added (nullable) to Document, Group, User for backward compatibility
TenantMiddleware resolves tenant from X-Tenant-ID header
POST /api/offline/generate returns a self-contained zip with HTML viewer
POST /api/import accepts zip/csv and creates documents with metadata
WebhookConfig model with HMAC signing support
POST /api/webhooks/{id}/test sends test payload with HMAC signature
All new tests pass with uv run pytest tests/ -x -q
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_health_score.py tests/test_scheduled_reports.py tests/test_tenants.py tests/test_offline.py tests/test_import_export.py tests/test_webhooks.py -x -q
uv run pytest tests/ -x -q (full test suite passes)
findings: All 42 new tests pass. Full suite 948 tests pass. One pre-existing flaky test (test_chat_enhanced.py::TestUnauthorizedAccess::test_cannot_access_other_users_session) fails due to rate limiter state accumulation during full suite runs - confirmed pre-existing by running without changes.
